description: This Java source file defines a singleton class 'MessageCommandMappingStrategies' that manages mapping strategies from signal types to JsonifiableMappers for message commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for initializing these strategies and extracting feature IDs from adaptables.

classes.name: MessageCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: Singleton class managing mapping strategies for message commands, extending AbstractMessageMappingStrategies with MessageCommand parameter specialization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageCommandMappingStrategies.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the mapping strategies HashMap associating signal types to JsonifiableMappers.

methods.name: featureIdForMessageFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID from the payload of an Adaptable object, throwing JsonParseException if not present.
